title: Christophany: The Road to Damascus (icon painting)
summary: An icon-style painting of Saul on the road to Damascus, kneeling on a rocky hillside as Christ appears in the sky, with the red caption 'Christophany' and 'The Road to Damascus'.

pictures.description: Byzantine-style icon or fresco on a blue background: two standing men in blue, pink and green robes beside a white horse, and a third man kneeling and covering his face with a cloak on a rocky golden hillside. In a circle of light at upper right a haloed figure in blue and gold robes reaches toward them, with a beam of light shining down. A walled city with red-tiled roofs stands in the background and a small tree grows at right.
pictures.text_in_picture: THE ROAD TO DAMASCUS; IC XC (Christ monogram, top right)
